description: vscode-jest 6.4.4 (T11.12, D125): the list-test-files request (process-session.ts:167): --listTests --json --watchAll=false, no --outputFile, --reporters or --colors. stdout's one array line is what the extension reads (process-listeners.ts:118,149-159), sorted as a set. The editor's spawner sets no CI and no NO_COLOR and the recorder sets both, so `env` has "CI": "false" (ci-info reads that as not CI) and removes NO_COLOR; both are test choices, not the editor's. The output file is a relative path inside the project (vscode-jest uses a name under os.tmpdir()), the reporter is the project's ./vscode-jest-reporter.js (the editor passes <ext>/out/reporter.js) and a file argument is relative (the editor passes an absolute path).
